verdicts.note: On fourier-transform, the input index j clashes with the root exponent j of roots-of-unity. Use another letter for the input index (e.g. i), since j is the exponent of the root on the earlier page.
On fourier-transform, the output index k clashes with the root exponent k of roots-of-unity. Use another letter for the output index (e.g. h), since k is the exponent of the root on the earlier page.
On convolution-reduction, the digit width b clashes with the second input sequence b of cyclic-convolution. Use another letter for the digit width (e.g. w).
On synthetic-transform, the input sequence x clashes with the formal variable x of the Fourier and cyclic convolution pages. Use another letter for the input sequence (e.g. u).
On synthetic-transform, the input sequence x clashes with the formal variable x of cyclic-convolution. Use another letter for the input sequence (e.g. u).
On address-interchange, the matrix size beta clashes with the head vertex beta of the linear network. Use another letter for the matrix size (e.g. q).
On address-interchange, the cost ratio lambda clashes with the example value lambda of linear-network-exchange. Use another letter for the cost ratio (e.g. kappa).
On chinese-remainder-address-map, the list position e clashes with the edge e of address-interchange. Use another letter for the list position (e.g. h).

On recursive-power-saving, W counts only the input roles, while on address-interchange W counts all wires including scratch wires. Use another letter for the role count, or state that W excludes scratch wires.
On recursive-power-saving, the smaller-call count s clashes with the field index s of address-shear. Use another letter for the smaller-call count (e.g. c).
On recursive-power-saving, the parameter multiplier m clashes with the matrix size m of lower-triangular-factorization. Use another letter for the parameter multiplier (e.g. g).
On recursive-power-saving, the smaller-call parameter e clashes with the edge e of address-interchange. Use another letter for the smaller-call parameter (e.g. f).
On recursive-power-saving, the level index l clashes with the level count l of address-interchange. Use another letter for the level index (e.g. i).
On recursive-power-saving, the saving exponent alpha clashes with the tail vertex alpha of linear-network-exchange. Use another letter for the saving exponent (e.g. gamma).
On gaussian-resampling, the source transform length s clashes with the field index s of address-shear. Use another letter for the source length (e.g. n_0).
On gaussian-resampling, the target transform length t clashes with the field index t of address-shear. Use another letter for the target length (e.g. n_1).
On gaussian-resampling, the identity constant c clashes with the cyclic convolution c of cyclic-convolution. Use another letter for the identity constant (e.g. C).
On bluestein-chirp, the wrapped coefficient alpha clashes with the tail vertex alpha of linear-network-exchange. Use another letter for the wrapped coefficient (e.g. gamma).
On rounding-recovery, the first digit array alpha clashes with the wrapped coefficient alpha of bluestein-chirp. Use another letter for the digit array (e.g. a).
On rounding-recovery, the first digit array alpha clashes with the tail vertex alpha of linear-network-exchange. Use another letter for the digit array (e.g. a).

On rounding-recovery, the second digit array beta clashes with the head vertex beta of linear-network-exchange. Use another letter for the digit array (e.g. b_2).
